module: Auxiliary "rim pull" controller (rim traction command, e.g. rail vehicles/tractors): an input axis input.rimPull (0..1) progressively reduces the torque converter's turbine clutch (from 1 to 0.2 between 0 and 0.5) then adds braking (from 0 to 1 between 0.5 and 1). It runs before vehicleController (defaultOrder 40) to modify input.brake before it is used.
notes: If the converter is not found, log D and updateGFX becomes nop.
input.rimPull is read but no input action in this file feeds it; it must come from the actions/bindings.
The controller modifies input.brake (max with the brake output) and relevantTorqueConverter.impellerClutchCoef.

updateGFX.desc: Every frame: converts input.rimPull into a turbine clutch target and additional braking.
